narrative: The [REDACTED_MALWARE] payload was a .NET application that dropped an installer for Adobe Flash v32 in %TEMP%\adobe.exe, and NetFlash (a .NET downloader) in %TEMP%\winhost.exe. In comparison to a regular cookie, it will be much more persistent as it won’t be deleted if the user just deletes the browser’s cookies. NetFlash downloads its second stage malware from a hardcoded URL and establishes persistence for this [REDACTED_MALWARE] using a Windows scheduled task.
